{{Top|leg}}
A '''brot''' was an animal which possessed an internal skeletal structure.

Brots were farmed in order to produce the edible delicacy known as [[brot-rib]]. Three opportunistic [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] trading material to the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] during the [[Swarm War]] asked [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to transport crates of brot-rib, in return for assistance finding their daughter [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] in the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]-Killik war zone.
